protocol.entry: next candle open after signal close
protocol.barriers: symmetric 1 ATR14 at signal close, minimum 0.4% of entry
protocol.resolution: first touch on complete 5m window; same 5m candle touching both = AMBIGUOUS
models: EMA benchmark plus XGBoost profitability filter
protocol.evaluation: non-overlapping episodes; cooldown expires at fixed horizon independent of future outcomes
protocol.adaptation: models trained on 2023, probabilities calibrated Jan-Jun 2024; frozen thereafter
protocol.integration: disabled; no inference of 100% accuracy or improvement; original Android engine must be compared separately on identical data before integration
protocol.scope: historical research; BUY/SELL are symmetric directional scenarios, not executed spot/short trades
